en: Color postcard showing a broad street intersection in an urban area with mid‑20th‑century architecture. At the corner stands a light-colored, five‑story administrative or institutional building with a small round tower-like stairwell and simple classical details. To the right along the avenue are more large rectangular buildings, likely offices or educational facilities, with trees and small lawns in front. Several trams and buses in cream and red colors run along the street, with a few 1950s‑style cars and pedestrians visible. Industrial chimneys rise in the distance. The image has a wide beige border at the bottom, typical of vintage printed postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.
